title: Microsoft named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for SIEM
description: Microsoft has been recognized as a Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) with its cloud-native SIEM product, Microsoft Sentinel. Sentinel integrates security data, advanced analytics, automation, and threat intelligence to provide comprehensive visibility and proactive threat detection across complex, multicloud environments. Microsoft also introduced the Integrated Security Operations Center (ISOC) in Microsoft Defender, which unifies SIEM with extended detection and response (XDR), threat intelligence, and posture management to enable faster, coordinated attack disruption. This integrated approach helps automatically contain threats such as ransomware and business email compromise, often disrupting ransomware attacks within 30 seconds. AI and automation capabilities in Sentinel reduce manual workload and accelerate investigations, enabling security teams to act more effectively against sophisticated threats.
